pages.title: Adopt
pages.content:
Demo page. All names, accounts and instructions here are fictional examples. Replace this text with your rescue information before sharing the site.

How adoption works

These are example steps. Replace them with your rescue’s process and fees.

  1. Read an animal’s profile. Look at their needs and think about your household.
  2. Send an application. Tell the team about your home and experience.
  3. Talk with the team. Ask questions and discuss the next steps together.

stories.title: Nimbus Sprout settles in (demo)
stories.text: In this fictional update, Nimbus learned where to rest and when to expect a walk. The example family kept the first week quiet and asked the team about his routine. This is sample content, not an account of a real adoption.
stories.pull_quote: We kept the first week quiet.

stories.title: Juniper Pixel settles in (demo)
stories.text: In this fictional update, Juniper had a separate resting space. The example family introduced one room at a time and wrote down questions for the team. This is sample content, not an account of a real adoption.
stories.pull_quote: A resting space helped us settle in.

stories.title: Mochi Comet settles in (demo)
stories.text: In this fictional update, Mochi explored a small room before meeting the rest of the household. The example family set out a bed and toys and let her choose when to approach. This is sample content, not an account of a real adoption.
stories.pull_quote: We let her choose when to approach.
